##### Project general facts

Address Villas Tierra by Emaar is an exclusive collection of luxury standalone villas with four, five and six bedrooms, designed for an elegant and comfortable lifestyle. Surrounded by shimmering waterways and lush green landscapes, the community combines contemporary architecture with a peaceful, resort-inspired atmosphere. The villas rise over two levels, with selected homes adding a basement or a roof terrace, and every residence enjoys private terraces and generous outdoor space for family living and entertaining.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of amenities, including a swimmable lagoon, swimming pools, beaches, community parks, playgrounds, and scenic jogging and cycling tracks. Wellness and spa facilities, sports courts, fitness areas, a clubhouse, and a community centre create a vibrant environment for relaxation, recreation, and social activities. Retail centres within the community bring everyday shopping and dining close to home, while landscaped streets and waterside promenades encourage residents to spend time outdoors throughout the year.

The villas feature contemporary architectural designs inspired by nature, with carefully selected glass, stone, steel, and wood elements that blend beautifully with the surrounding landscape. Spacious interiors are designed to capture natural light and showcase beautiful views, creating a bright, refined, and welcoming living environment. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

The Oasis is an exclusive residential community in Dubai, offering a peaceful and luxurious lifestyle surrounded by lush greenery, landscaped gardens, and beautiful water features. Its thoughtfully designed environment creates a welcoming atmosphere where residents can enjoy privacy, comfort, and a sense of tranquility away from the city's busy pace. Lagoons, beaches and parks sit at the heart of the master plan, giving families a resort-style setting within reach of the main business districts.

The community is designed to promote outdoor living, with scenic walking paths, open green spaces, and inviting areas for relaxation and recreation. Residents can enjoy a balanced lifestyle that combines the beauty of nature with the comfort and convenience of a modern residential destination. Schools, clinics, supermarkets and community retail are planned within the community and nearby districts, keeping everyday needs close at hand.

The Oasis benefits from its location in Dubai, providing access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Qudra Road and Emirates Road and convenient connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Hills and both international airports. With its serene surroundings, elegant residential setting, and emphasis on well-being, the community offers an appealing choice for families and individuals seeking a refined lifestyle in Dubai.
